So when I was around like 8 or 9 (don't Remember exactly age) I said to myself "if you dont do coke shrooms and weed by the time you get out of high school then your a loser". Well I made it out of high school without doing shrooms and coke but I did smoke weed. So is it time for me to do shrooms or should I do lsd first?
Shrooms leave you more connected to the real world than LSD. Both are wonderful, either way I recommend a trip adviser. Someone who has tripped lots before hand.

Hey man, it sounds like you're looking to try shrooms just for the sake of trying shrooms? Personally, I waited till I was at least 21 and I wouldn't have done them any younger...but if you're dead set on doing them ASAP, nobody can really dissuade you. For your first time, make sure you're in a comfortable and familiar setting. Go outside if you like, as long as you won't be bothered by anyone or get otherwise stressed out mid-trip. Have a friend with you, the more positive and happy the better.

I made my first batch as a tea and it worked amazingly well. I drank the first half really quick and got the second half down over the next 15 min. Before it kicked in, my friend and I drove 5 min to a public golf course that was closed for the season, but it was too cold. After spending about 5 more min there, we decided to just go back home where it was warm and cozy. On the short drive home it kicked in...THANKFULLY I was only 30 sec from my house. I knew it hit because it came on in a wave of euphoria all at once. I could still function, I wasn't tripping yet, but I knew I was well on my way.

Using the tea method, it took around 15-20 min for it to kick in.

It you just eat them, it may take about 30 min, but that's without taking any variables into account...pure estimate.

If I were you, I'd wait and stick with weed if you want to get high. I've found that shrooms really help open my mind and change my perspective of the world, but I only use them when I can/when I feel I need much deeper insight than I'd normally be capable of - if you take them for the sake of taking them, you might not recognize how your mind and emotional health could benefit from the drug while you're just giggling at how silly everything looks.

Like I said, if you're dead-set on taking them, just make sure your surroundings are as friendly and comfortable as possible. I use them for a purpose, not for fun, so my perspective may not be the one you want, but I figure you could use as much info as possible before trying shrooms your first time.

Best of luck, and kudos on beating depression! Been there, and I'm glad to be able to congratulate you :)
